name: capy-dash
description: Capy Dash - a tiny retro pixel platformer (web, Android, iOS)

scripts.android:init: npx cap add android && node scripts/native-setup.mjs
scripts.ios:init: npx cap add ios && node scripts/native-setup.mjs
scripts.sync: node tools/gen-palette.js && npx cap sync && node scripts/native-setup.mjs
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
